text_block_list.name: Cheerful Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Man, that performance just now was 
seriously good, wasn't it?

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Heh, looks like I can finally play it 
without messing up. 
I practiced like hell, so I guess that's 
only natural.

text_block_list.name: Timid-Looking Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, Espo-san, was that the song from the 
game earlier?

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. Played it so much I memorized it 
even without sheet music.

text_block_list.name: Timid-Looking Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
A-Ah, me too... I've got about half of it 
down. 
It's such a fun song, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Cheerful Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Hey, what's the fingering during the 
chorus of that song again? 
Show me, Espo-chan.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
When you're not messing up, your sound is 
seriously amazing, so puff your chest out 
with pride. 
Your pals are coming to watch, right?

text_block_list.name: Timid-Looking Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yeah...! 
You're right...!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, it's hard to believe the tense mood 
we had until recently was even real.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, it totally blew me away too. 
Even the ensemble rehearsals have been 
incredible lately.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Hey! What're you two smirking at me for, 
huh?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
We're not talking smack or anything. Just 
saying you've looked like you're having a 
lot of fun practicing lately.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Before you knew it, your connection 
expanded, and now you're just overflowing 
with positive energy. That's amazing! Did 
something happen to spark it?

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Huh? What's with you all of a sudden? 
...It's not really a big deal.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
At first, I had no clue what to even say 
to 'em. 
But while we were playing that game, I 
kinda just figured it out.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Like, "Oh. These guys laugh at the exact 
same stuff I do." 
I bet... it was the same from their 
perspective too.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
...If you don't face people head-on, 
you'll never know, y'know? 
Turns out there were tons of things I 
wasn't seeing.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Face people head-on?

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. They've got their own reasons for 
wanting to try hard, and people they wanna 
look cool for. ...Like someone they wanna 
make smile.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
So, I also... 
—Gah! Forget it! Cancel that! Forget I 
said anything!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Whoa...! I see, so that's what it was! 
You can't create that kind of positive 
energy on your own.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Only by truly connecting with everyone's 
hearts could such a massive shift in the 
flow be born...!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
One, two, three, four♪ 
One, two, three, four♪

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Yeah, yeah☆ Looking good, looking good~♪

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Okay♪ Everyone is looking super good. 
At this rate, the real performance is 
gonna be fantastic☆

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
"Looking good" my ass. 
Why're you two the only ones wearing your 
costumes already, hey?!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Ehe♪ The samples just arrived, so we 
wanted to show them off☆ 
The contrast between the two costume 
styles looks amazing, don't you think?♪

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Don't gimme that "ehe~♪"! Hurry up and 
hand over ours too!

text_block_list.name: Cheerful Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, what she said! 
Espo-chan is totally right!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. The fact that our performance has 
come together so well is all thanks to 
this team's atmosphere. 
Perhaps we even have Espo-san's little 
incident to thank for that.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Mmmgh, I'm feeling so Copa-Copa inspired! 
Time to do a full review of the staging 
proposal I submitted to the committee!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Ohh? 
What got into you all of a sudden, 
Rickey-chan?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Because a single spark of change 
transformed the team this much! 
I'm certain there are still plenty of 
things we can change for the better!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
My ideas can definitely bring happiness to 
even more people! 
I'm gonna polish them up even further 
before the big day!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Huh. So you're saying the light show plans 
are gonna get even more insane, then? 
...Heh, fine by me. The flashier, the 
better.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, but it's not just about being 
flashy! I'm tweaking it so the lighting 
color palette shifts over time, altering 
the good-luck effects!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
That way, guests won't have to chase the 
parade across different zones to receive 
every single blessing of good fortune! 
Isn't that amazing?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
I'm having them submit those adjustment 
proposals today too! 
I hope Falco-san's meeting wraps up soon~♪

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
No way...! 
Isn't there anything that can be done...!?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: !? Was that... Falco-san's voice?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Canceling the parade... No way...!

text_block_list.name: Espoir & Ricky
text_block_list.text: Huh?!
